device.modelDescription: Step module of the ch-packs family: masks secrets and personal data in the text lines it is handed, so that no token, key or address in a log line can reach a scenario's result. A pure function of its input: no disk, no network, no state. Its patterns are regular expressions; it is a safety net applied to everything a scenario returns, not a guarantee.

actionList.name: redact
actionList.description: Masks the lines you supply and returns them in the same order, with every match replaced whole by a tag: authorization header credentials, Bearer, Basic and token (<token>), GitHub tokens, installation tokens and a 40-hex token after "token" (<githubToken>), AWS access key ids and secret access keys, a bare one too (<awsKey>), Slack, Stripe, Google, npm, GitLab, Anthropic and OpenAI keys and Slack webhook URLs (<apiKey>), the value of a password, secret, token, API key, credential, private key, pwd, pass or auth assigned with = (or with : as a key, in JSON and in escaped JSON too; camelCase and glued names too), a secret flag's value, a secret header's value and every cookie value, a value to its end, a quoted value whole (<secret>, the name kept), private key blocks, PGP's included (<privateKey>, one line for the whole block, so the line count can change), and a bare key body, JWTs (<jwt>), credentials in a URL: a password (after a user that is an e-mail address too), or a user long enough to be a token (://<basicAuth>@), e-mail addresses (<email>), IPv4 addresses (<ipv4>), card numbers that pass the Luhn check (<card>) and phone numbers (<phone>). A GitHub Actions marker at a line's start (##[error], ##[warning]) is kept, and the text after it is masked as a line of its own. Also returns how many matches of each type were replaced. A count of zero is not evidence that the text holds no secret or personal data: the patterns catch the shapes listed, nothing else. Each line given back is masked first, then cut to 500 characters with …; a line taken in over 20000 characters is never cut: it is replaced whole by "(a line of N characters, omitted)".
